_note: Presentation colours (0-255) and the water's light the core draws with (crates/core/src/look.rs). players: the four lobby seats' colours, filling a model's "player" slot. ink: a tile's letter and value, plain and in a real word. water: lightly underwater and cartoony. light.fog is the murk at eye level and the fog's colour; zenith the murk overhead, down the murk looking down, each turning in over its band (hundredths of the view's height); sheen the light from the surface. shafts fan from the surface (counts stripes to the radian, drifting once round in drift_ms; strength and power in hundredths; fade: cosines from the light where they fade in and are whole). caustics: three ripples (wavelength, heading, period) whose meeting lines make the net on faces that look up, power their sharpness, strength_pct their brightness. gallery: the sand disc (floor colour, floor_pct of the camera's distance across), one turn of the turntable in turn_seconds, the field of view, margin_pct room round a model, the fog from and to fog_pct of the camera's distance, and the zoom: each step zoom_step_pct, between zoom_pct of the fitted distance.

held._note: A tile in a claw is drawn at tile_pct of its size (the crab is under half a tile across, SECOND-ORDER R1.8); it shrinks over change_ms when grabbed and grows back as it is let go. Placed and ghost tiles are full size. tilt_deg: a held tile's face tipped up from flat, back toward the camera behind the crab, so its letter reads (a grabbed tile is always held face up, flipping over as it shrinks). spread_mm: each held tile set out sideways from its claw so two sit side by side.

marks._note: The word marks (crates/core/src/marks.rs), mm. outline: the line in the owner's colour all the way round a word, at the board (F8): a strip on the board at the tiles' feet (foot_y_mm high, from the wall out to foot_out_mm from a square's middle; a square is 210, a tile 200), a wall up the tile's side at wall_mm to top_y_mm (a tile's top is 85), and a rim on the tile's top edge from rim_in_mm (a tile's value sits up to 87 from its middle). A word that is not real is dashed: dashes to a square's side, each dash_pct of its share. board: the ring round a ghost tile's foot: y_mm its height, inner_mm its inner edge from the square's middle, width_mm its width, lip_mm a skirt hanging from its outer edge; radius_mm rounds its corners, step_mm lifts it; dash_mm is about one dash. grab: the see-through collar round a loose tile a free claw could grab (F6), in the tile's frame: inner_mm from its middle, width_mm wide, its top top_mm over the tile's bottom face (a tile is 45 thick) and hanging to the bottom, alpha_pct solid, in the ghost's colour. ghost: the ghost ring's colour (sea-glass aqua, BRIEF.md's Style).

play._note: The game's screen (crates/core/src/app/view3d.rs). fov_deg: the third-person camera's vertical field of view; near_mm and far_mm its planes; fog_mm: where the water's fog starts and ends; live_mm: how far from the camera the map's swaying and see-through things (weed, kelp, anemones, fish, light shafts) are drawn, each frame (beyond it they are mostly fog); popup_ms: how long a "-2" popup shows. overhead: the board from above in the bottom-left corner (the top-left on a touch screen): size_pct of the screen's short side (big_pct while Tab is held), margin_pct of it from its corner, fov_deg its narrow field of view (nearly flat), room_pct round the board; each crab a see-through circle circle_mm across, alpha_pct solid, lifted lift_mm over the board, with sides edges.

tally._note: The tally's reveal (crates/core/src/app/tally.rs): the first word shows first_ms after the end, then one line every line_ms (a word, or the idle penalty), each player's column in seat order with gap_ms more between players (a player with no line still takes one line's time), and the winner winner_ms after the last line.

title._note: The title card behind the Title menu (crates/core/src/app/title.rs; the scene is data/scenes/title.json). tilt_deg: the camera looks this much further down than the scene's own, so the card sits high, over the menu. Its idle motion, kept slight: each tile bobs bob_mm up and down and rocks rock_deg once every bob_ms, out of step with its neighbours; each bubble rises rise_mm once every rise_ms, swaying sway_mm, growing in at the bottom and shrinking away at the top; the camera drifts drift_deg round and back once every drift_ms.
title._crabs: The crabs about the card (F4; crates/core/src/app/title_life.rs): each scuttles sideways from `from` to `to` (x and z on the sand, mm) at speed_mm_per_s and back, resting rest_ms at each end (at from, at to), start_ms into its round at the clock's 0, facing the camera's side of its path. One with a letter carries that tile, setting it down at each end and picking it up again as it leaves. Red crosses in front of the card, yellow fusses with a tile beside the menu, blue peeks out from behind the E, purple ambles on the left. fish: each swims from `from` to `to` (mm) in swim_ms, then is out of sight for rest_ms.

crab._note: A crab's motion past its keyed moves (TRIAGE F12, crates/core/src/app/crab_pose.rs), drawn from its gait, speed, turn, time in the air and last grab or place. bob_mm: the body's dip each step. lean_deg / pitch_deg: its roll into a scuttle and pitch into a forward or back walk at full speed; turn_lean_deg: its bank into a turn of half a turn a second; lean_ms: how quickly these follow. stretch_pct over stretch_ms: taller leaving the ground. squash_pct over squash_ms: shorter landing from a full jump, with a rebound. eye_lag_deg: the eye stalks trail a move or turn; eye_bounce_deg: their nod on landing. claw_sway_deg: the claws' swing as it walks. snap_deg / snap_ms: a claw's squeeze after a grab and two clacks after a place. A crab standing still fidget_after_ms fidgets (looks about, clacks its empty claws or shifts its weight) every fidget_every_ms, for fidget_ms, up to fidget_deg.

legs._note: The legs (TRIAGE F1, crates/core/src/app/crab_pose/legs.rs): each foot stands on the ground or tile under it and steps when it is step_mm from its place under the body (settle_mm when the crab stands still), lifted lift_mm over the higher end and set down over step_ms, lead_ms of the crab's speed ahead of its place; two alternating fours (left 1 and 3 with right 2 and 4). The body rises or sinks follow_pct of the way to the feet's mean height (at most body_mm) and tilts to them (at most tilt_deg). The keyed jump takes the legs over blend_ms after take-off and gives them back over blend_ms after landing.

colourblind._note: Colourblind mode (Settings, F16; crates/core/src/look.rs ColourblindLook). players: the seats' colours from the Okabe-Ito set, told apart under deuteranopia, protanopia and tritanopia (vermilion, yellow, blue, reddish purple), the seats keeping their names. ink: a real word's letters in a deep blue, readable on the wood and apart from the near-black plain ink under every simulation. board: the board model's premium colours, darker triples and lighter doubles, warm words and cool letters. thick_pct: word outlines this much wider. Each seat also gets a symbol (triangle, square, plus, star): over each other player's crab, symbol_mm across and symbol_up_mm over its feet, in its colour on a symbol_rim rim; on its overhead circle in symbol_ink, overhead_pct of the circle's width; and on every crab's shell (your own too), shell_mm across and shell_up_mm up in shell_ink on a symbol_rim rim.

touch._note: The touch controls on a phone or tablet (crates/core/src/app/touch.rs), in CSS pixels for a phone whose short side is short_px; a bigger screen scales them up to scale_max_pct. The claws' buttons claw_px across sit round the jump button jump_px in the bottom-right corner, margin_px from the edges and gap_px apart; the pause button is small_px. The thumbstick's ring is stick_px across; it walks a way once it leans dead_pct of its radius that way. A drag on the right half turns look_pct percent as much as the mouse for the same pixels.
